title: Select All Objects By Layer

oracle.positive: Select all objects in active layer returns exactly its editable objects
oracle.negative: Hidden/locked objects must respect selectable policy without silent override

manual_reviewer_checklist.scope_note: The policy is machine-proven; the gesture's feel (right-click a colour swatch / row) is yours to confirm.

items.step: Right-click the Gems swatch with two objects on it.
items.machine_proven: A1/A2: exactly the two Gems objects are selected and a second gesture replaces the set.
items.human_must_verify: Both objects highlight; another layer's object never joins the selection.

items.step: Hide one object of the layer, then use the gesture again.
items.machine_proven: A3: the hidden object stays out.
items.human_must_verify: Only the visible object is selected and no hidden object is silently included.

items.step: Lock the layer and use the gesture.
items.machine_proven: B1/B3: nothing is selected and the previous selection is cleared, not kept.
items.human_must_verify: The selection empties instead of leaving a stale highlight, and no error dialog appears.

items.step: Use the group gesture (the block toggle) and Undo afterwards.
items.machine_proven: A4/B4: the group gesture obeys the same policy and the gesture writes no transaction.
items.human_must_verify: Group selection matches row selection, and Undo has nothing to undo from selecting.
